title: Pull five facts out of a 6,000-line program output
prompt:
pipeline.py simulates our nightly reconciliation run: it prints about 6,000 log lines and takes roughly half a minute. I need a few facts from one run, written to answers.json in the workspace root, in exactly this shape:

{
  "checksum_ledger_0417": "<the checksum of batch 0417 of the ledger stage>",
  "warn_lines_normalize": <how many WARN lines the normalize stage printed>,
  "error": {"line": <the number at the start of the one ERROR line>, "code": "<its code, like E123>"},
  "slowest": {"stage": "<stage of the batch with the highest ms of the whole run>", "batch": <its batch number>},
  "total_ms": <the total the last line reports>
}

Don't change pipeline.py.
